measurements.name: simulated_stripe_wavelength_um
measurements.method: radial FFT peak of the saturated activator on the 96² grid, times µm/px
measurements.note: Saturated nonlinear peak need not sit exactly on the linear k_c; reference is the assigned scale, not a copy of the measurement.

measurements.name: linear_critical_wavelength_um
measurements.method: λ = 2π/k_c with k_c² = γ √(det J /(D_u D_v)) at the operating γ
measurements.reference_source: nominal 77 µm label; exact calibration target is 77.44 µm
measurements.note: Operating-point calibration versus the rounded 77 µm label.

measurements.name: dispersion_pearson_r
measurements.method: Pearson r of binned analytic vs Euler growth rates σ(k²_disc)

measurements.name: dispersion_rmse
measurements.method: RMSE between binned analytic and numeric σ
measurements.note: Includes the discrete-Laplacian symbol, not a continuum k² approximation.

measurements.name: dispersion_ks_statistic
measurements.method: two-sample KS statistic between analytic and numeric σ samples

measurements.name: gamma_sweep_mode_pearson_r
measurements.method: Pearson r of analytic vs numeric fastest-mode index across an 8-point γ sweep
measurements.note: k_c scales as √γ; this is the parameter-expressivity check for wavelength selection.

measurements.name: on_band_amplitude_ratio
measurements.method: mode-8 cosine amplitude after 500 steps divided by its initial amplitude
measurements.note: On-band control at m = 8 (12 px = 77.44 µm). Ratio > 1 means the band amplifies.

measurements.name: off_band_amplitude_ratio
measurements.method: mode-2 cosine amplitude after 500 steps divided by its initial amplitude
measurements.note: Negative control: a 48 px stripe is outside the Turing band and must decay.

measurements.name: equal_diffusion_amplitude_ratio
measurements.method: mode-8 amplitude ratio with D_v reset equal to D_u
measurements.reference_source: same seed and mode with D_v/D_u = 16
measurements.note: Ablation: equal diffusion fails D_v f_u + D_u g_v > 0, so the ratio collapses relative to the Turing run.

measurements.name: specimen_cap_circularity
measurements.method: 4π Area / Perimeter² of the largest brown gill-disc component
measurements.note: The photographed cap is torn around the stipe and is not a perfect circle.

measurements.name: specimen_gill_stripe_coherency
measurements.method: mean structure-tensor coherency inside the gill-disc mask
measurements.reference_source: same photograph, coherency averaged over the whole frame (grass plus cap)
measurements.note: Cap lamellae versus the grass-dominated frame. Values differ; neither is copied onto the other.

measurements.name: specimen_cap_segment_fraction
measurements.method: pixel fraction of the largest gill-brown connected component
measurements.note: Real foreground fraction of the cap on Igor Yevdokimov's 2015 photograph.

measurements.name: specimen_foreground_fraction
measurements.method: fraction of pixels whose luminance differs from the border median by > 0.06
measurements.note: The fruiting body and grass fill the frame; this is not a line plot.

measurements.name: detail_variant_ratio_vs_tier_floor
measurements.reference_source: a pattern sitting on the tier floor rather than the detail variant
measurements.note: Chronoseries 1/1 has no predecessor species. The 10 µm floor is the scale contrast: γ would have to rise by DETAIL_RATIO², or D_u D_v fall by DETAIL_RATIO⁴, to select 10 µm instead of 77.44 µm at Holocene age 0.
